name: tier-scope-test-pins-message-substrings
body: The cumulative-scope unit test pins the production validators' message substrings (`driven-by no Service`, `realised by no Component`, `requires no Requirement`, and the dangling-endpoint phrasing) rather than their full text, so a deliberate reword of any of those messages needs a matching update in this test. Upgrade only when one of those messages is intentionally changed; the assertions are substring matches by design so unrelated wording elsewhere does not couple them.
